uncertainty.coder_notes: The female-students removal is absorbed into the female-professionals Reframed pairing rather than emitted as a standalone Removed event, because the antecedent overlap is defensible and emitting both would double-count. The gender-fluid inclusivity sizing is coded as New because no PRE antecedent explicitly references gender-neutral sizing or gender-fluid consumers, even though it is structurally tied to the gay-men pairing. The functional-footwear elaborations (comfort + dancer/performer use case) are coded as two distinct events because their successors diverge into different functional contexts.
